stories.title: Cirio, taglio bollo non sarà un onere delle Regioni

en.title: Cirio, stamp duty cut will not be a burden on regions
en.summary: A regional official states that the government and center-right coalition will not impose the cost of reducing vehicle stamp duty on regional administrations.

stories.title: Cdm approva decreto, via il bollo su auto piccole e taglio delle accise fino al 5 ottobre

en.title: Cabinet approves decree, vehicle stamp duty eliminated for small cars and excise tax cut until October 5
en.summary: The government approved measures exempting vehicles with power up to 80 kW from stamp duty in 2027 and reducing fuel excise taxes to 12.2 cents per liter.

stories.title: Meloni, abolizione del bollo pensata per chi usa auto e moto ogni giorno

en.title: Meloni, stamp duty abolition designed for those using cars and motorcycles daily
en.summary: The prime minister describes the stamp duty elimination as a straightforward structural measure, using resources previously allocated to address fuel price increases.

stories.title: Bozza dl, esenzione bollo nel 2027 per auto fino a 80kw

en.title: Draft decree, stamp duty exemption in 2027 for vehicles up to 80kw
en.summary: A proposed decree includes vehicle stamp duty exemptions starting in 2027 for cars up to 80 kilowatts, with excise tax cuts scheduled to decrease after September 25.

stories.title: Via il bollo auto per auto piccole e medie e moto. Meloni: "Una delle tasse più odiate"

en.title: Car tax abolished for small and medium cars and motorcycles. Meloni: "One of the most hated taxes"
en.summary: Italy will eliminate the car tax in 2027 for motorcycles and over 70 percent of cars currently in circulation, with each citizen eligible for one exemption.

stories.title: Il governo abolisce il bollo per le auto piccole e medie. Stop anche per i motocicli

en.title: Government abolishes car tax for small and medium cars. Halt for motorcycles too
en.summary: The government will cancel the car tax in 2027 for small and medium automobiles and motorcycles, removing what Meloni calls one of the most disliked taxes among Italians.

stories.title: Tour di Ed Sheeran nella bufera: defezioni e solidarietà a Macklemore, si era espresso pro Palestina

en.title: Ed Sheeran's tour in turmoil: defections and solidarity with Macklemore, who spoke out for Palestine
en.summary: Multiple artists including Finneas, Lukas Graham, Aaron Rowe, and Beoga have withdrawn from Ed Sheeran's tour in protest over the exclusion of rapper Macklemore, who had expressed support for Palestine.

stories.title: Abolito il bollo auto e moto, taglio delle accise fino al 5 ottobre: ecco le decisioni del governo

en.title: Car and motorcycle tax abolished, fuel tax cut extended until October 5: government decisions
en.summary: The government has eliminated the tax on motorcycles and small to medium cars up to 80 kW, while extending a fuel tax discount through October 5.

stories.title: Gaza, crolla un palazzo: almeno 20 i morti tra cui 8 bambini

en.title: Gaza, building collapses: at least 20 dead including 8 children
en.summary: A building in Gaza that had been damaged by Israeli bombardment but remained standing collapsed, killing at least 20 people including children. The structure had sheltered displaced residents, with rescue efforts hampered by lack of heavy equipment.

stories.title: Roger Waters contro Ed Sheeran. E il tour si svuota dopo l’esclusione di Macklemore

en.title: Roger Waters against Ed Sheeran. Tour empties after Macklemore's exclusion
en.summary: Several artists including Finneas, Aaron Rowe, Lukas Graham, and Beoga announced their withdrawal from Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with rapper Macklemore.

stories.title: Thaci condannato a 25 anni per crimini di guerra. A Pristina lanci di pietre contro sede Ue

en.title: Thaci convicted of 25 years for war crimes. Stone-throwing at EU headquarters in Pristina
en.summary: Former Kosovo president and UCK leader Thaci was convicted by The Hague tribunal along with three commanders for war crimes. The verdict prompted stone-throwing at EU offices in Pristina, raising regional tension concerns.

stories.title: Bufera Ed Sheeran, Macklemore fuori dal tour per le frasi su Gaza. Lasciano altri artisti Video

en.title: Ed Sheeran controversy, Macklemore out of tour over Gaza statements. Other artists leave
en.summary: Support artists for Ed Sheeran's Loop Tour American leg, including Finneas and Irish band Beoga, officially withdrew from the tour.

stories.title: Sulle Linee Vesuviane dieci nuovi treni che assicureranno frequenze di 30 minuti

en.title: Ten new trains on the Vesuvian Lines will ensure 30-minute frequencies
en.summary: Ten new trains have been delivered to the Vesuvian Lines, a railway network operated by Eav and controlled by the Campania Region, with a new timetable established to provide service at 30-minute intervals.

stories.title: Michelin, il sito di Alessandria punta sulla seconda vita degli pneumatici

en.title: Michelin, the Alessandria site focuses on the second life of tyres
en.summary: The Piedmont Michelin facility, marking 55 years of operation, has invested over 400 million in technology and flexibility over five years to focus on tire recycling and reuse.

stories.title: Decathlon in Italia apre al franchising

en.title: Decathlon in Italy opens to franchising
en.summary: Decathlon Italy is shifting its expansion strategy by opening to franchising, with plans to open 91 medium to large-sized stores throughout Italy by 2030.

stories.title: Chiesti i fondi per completare il polo Agroalimentare delle Dop

en.title: Funds requested to complete the Agrifood Hub of Protected Designations of Origin
en.summary: Funding is being sought to complete the redevelopment of La Balzana, Italy's largest property complex seized from organized crime, which will become a regional agrifood park showcasing Campania's typical products.

stories.title: Caputi: «Il turismo ha bisogno di una strategia industriale di medio-lungo periodo»

en.title: Caputi: "Tourism needs a medium to long-term industrial strategy"
en.summary: Tourism industry leaders met to discuss the need for a comprehensive medium to long-term industrial strategy that supports investment, competitiveness, innovation, employment, and business growth across the sector.
